title: Raccoon with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="22" rx="12" ry="10" fill="#8B6F9E"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="22" rx="12" ry="10" fill="#8B6F9E"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="22" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#D4A5D4"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="22" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#D4A5D4"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="30" ry="26" fill="#9B8FAF"/>
  <!-- face mask dark -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="26" ry="16" fill="#6B5B8A"/>
  <!-- white face patches -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#C8BED6"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="16" ry="10" fill="#E8E0F0"/>
  <!-- eye patches white -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="48" rx="11" ry="9" fill="#F0EAF8"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="48" rx="11" ry="9" fill="#F0EAF8"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="48" r="7" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="48" r="7" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="46" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="46" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="49" r="1" fill="#E0D0FF"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="49" r="1" fill="#E0D0FF"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#3D2B5A"/>
  <!-- nose shine -->
  <ellipse cx="48.5" cy="57" rx="1.5" ry="1" fill="#A78FD0"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M46 62 Q50 66 54 62" stroke="#5A4B75" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="55" r="4" fill="#C97BA8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="55" r="4" fill="#C97BA8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- sparkle accents around face -->
  <path d="M20 30 L22 26 L24 30 L22 34 Z" fill="#FFF0A0"/>
  <path d="M78 28 L80 24 L82 28 L80 32 Z" fill="#FFF0A0"/>
  <path d="M82 62 L83.5 59 L85 62 L83.5 65 Z" fill="#B0E0FF"/>
  <path d="M16 60 L17.5 57 L19 60 L17.5 63 Z" fill="#B0E0FF"/>
</svg>
